stemMarkdown: The recurring decimal $0.\overline{743}$ (the block $743$ repeating) is written as a fraction in lowest terms. What is its denominator?
solutionMarkdown: A block of $3$ repeating digits sits over $999$: $0.\overline{743} = \dfrac{743}{999}$. Reducing by the HCF $1$ gives $\dfrac{743}{999}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: One repeating digit sits over 9, two over 99, three over 999 — the pattern continues.
